motors.ref_pattern.measured_on: naming habit, decided and not measured on any project; set it to how motors, their connectors and plugs are named. A body the pattern does not match is not taken for a motor
motors.ref_pattern.description: a bought or mesh body whose name, or the name of a component above it, matches is a motor or a connector

rules.title: The plug and its leads have a way in and a way out
rules.statement: Every motor pocket has a through channel for the connector and the first bend of its leads: at least {motors.channel_width} wide (the plug of {motors.plug_width} by {motors.plug_height} is a placeholder, plus {motors.connector_clearance} per side), open along the whole insertion path, with no fastener in it. A part that encloses a motor has a lead exit for every motor length in use. A cable window passes the mated plug, not bare wires.
rules.why: The largest part of a build was printed with no opening for the motor leads: the motor reference was a box and hid the connector. The first fix was a guessed groove although the plug had been measured. Another base was printed again because the plug did not pass its window.
fix_order: Measure the plug and write it into the project parameters (tag M).
Size the channel from the plug plus the clearance, along the whole insertion path.
Move a fastener out of the channel and keep the count.

attest.question: Motor or connector in or beside this part: what is the way in and the way out for the plug and its leads?
labels: no motor and no connector in or beside this part
the channel passes the measured plug and the first bend of its leads along the whole insertion path; no fastener in it

auto.label: no motor and no connector in or beside this part

rules.note: Asked once per changed part, and only where a motor or a connector is near: the unit fusion_near lists the bought and mesh bodies whose bounding box comes within process.near_margin of the part's box. A name can only make the question asked. When none of them matches motors.ref_pattern (the body, its component or a component above it) AND every one of them is a fastener by its name, the gate answers "no motor and no connector" itself and the report lists that under "answered by facts". A bought or mesh body under any other name (the "Rotor" of a motor model, a servo named by its type) leaves the question asked. With no facts of that unit the question is asked.

rules.title: The plug is swept along its path
rules.statement: The connector with the first bend of its leads is swept along its insertion path and through the travel of the joint, and touches nothing.
rules.why: Nothing swept a plug along its path: a missing channel was found with the printed part in hand.

attest.question: Sweep of the plug along its insertion path and through the travel of the joint: does it touch anything?
labels: swept along the insertion path and through the travel: free
no motor and no connector in or beside this part

rules.note: Deferred: becomes a sweep check. Until then motors.lead_path asks.

rules.title: A motor reference is the real motor
rules.statement: Every motor reference is the real model at its real length, with its connector and leads, and the owner's measurements applied at once: never a box. The shaft (its length, where the flat starts) is measured per batch before a part that sits on the shaft is printed.
rules.why: A box reference hid the connector of a motor. A printed cam did not seat on the shaft of a newer motor batch.

rules.title: A motor goes in as an assembled unit
rules.statement: A motor goes in with its gearbox as a unit assembled on the bench. The insertion motion of every sub-assembly is swept. A part that fits only when it is teleported into place is a defect.
rules.why: A joint could not be assembled as drawn.

rules.title: Every cable has a route, anchors and room for its plug
rules.statement: Every part along a cable route has tie anchors that can be printed, and every joint has its own service loop and strain relief. A cable passage is sized for the largest thing that passes: the connector housing. The cable bundle and its ties are bodies in clearance checks. Anchors are bolt-on clips, not features cut at absolute positions.
rules.why: A printed bracket had no cable holders: anchors cut at absolute positions were lost when the stack above it moved 3 mm.

rules.title: Plastic on a motor case stays stiff when the case is hot
rules.statement: A printed part that touches a motor case is in a material that stays stiff at the temperature the case reaches.
rules.why: No lost print is on record. A hot motor case can reach the softening range of common filaments.
